items.title: Three equivalent descriptions of the quotient topology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the triple description of the quotient topology (author lemma at source lines 691-701, label lemma-quotient): it is the strongest topology making the surjection continuous, and its opens and closed sets are exactly those with open resp. closed preimages. The proof (source lines 703-733) is a complete verification: the family of subsets with open preimage is shown to be a topology (proof lines 704-710), maximality among topologies making the map continuous is checked (proof lines 710-730), and the closed-set form is obtained from the preimage-of-complement identity (proof lines 731-732). The lemma is the companion of the induced-topology lemma and is the reference point for the chapter's results on submersive maps. H2.
